FLVA-A-52623.kennel_description:
Meet Kitty — a gentle, sweet 2-year-old girl looking for a calm home and a patient human to
love.

Kitty is shy at first, but once she feels safe, she adores gentle affection, belly rubs, cozy cat
beds, and quiet companionship. She’s especially wonderful with other cats and would make an
amazing feline friend for a cat who needs a buddy.

She thrives with calm people, slow introductions, and predictable routines. Loud environments
and fast movements make her nervous, so she’s hoping for a quieter home where she can
blossom at her own pace.

Kitty may take a little time to trust, but her foster family promises: she is absolutely worth the
wait.

If you believe the best relationships are earned slowly and lovingly, Kitty may be your perfect
match.

FLVA-A-3014.kennel_description:
Lola’s story is simple: she loves people, and she’s been waiting patiently for the person who will love her right back.

This beautiful brindle girl walks like a pro on leash, greeting the world with curiosity and kindness. On her park outings, she trots happily beside her humans, stopping often for snuggles and scratches — her favorite part of any adventure.

In her foster home, Lola has been a joy. She’s house trained, crate trained, affectionate, and wonderfully easy to redirect. She’s calm in the house, not destructive, and happiest when she can curl up next to her humans. Her foster calls her a “Velcro dog,” and Lola wears that title proudly.

She loves car rides, public outings, toys, and tasty treats. She does have a high prey drive, so she needs a home without cats or small pets. She has done well with the resident dog after a very slow introduction, but she would likely thrive most as the only dog.

Lola is ready for her forever home — one filled with patience, comfort, and endless love. If you’re looking for a loyal companion who will adore you every single day, Lola is waiting.

FLVA-A-52858.kennel_description:
Meet Rocher!

Rocher is a hound with a nose for rest and relaxation!

This gentleman loves to luxuriate in a sunny spot and take a long nap after breakfast and brief morning walk. His perfect day is filled with soft blankets and treats.

His ideal home has multiple snuggle spots for him to pick from, plenty of snacks, and someone to tell him all about their day. He enjoys an occasional play bow and zoomie scoot session with his close human friends followed by hours of peace and quiet.

Rocher is not your typical hound. He isn’t eager to run for miles or vigorous rustle and tussle play. He adores the simple pleasures and looks forward a quiet life with people who love hims as much as he loves them.

He is shy with new people and will need a family who is ok going slow and letting him gain confidence overtime. What charming introvert doesn't need a minute to build trust?

Apply to adopt Rocher today or come and meet him at the shelter!

FLVA-A-52983.kennel_description:
Meet McNugget!

Dreamy McNugget is just what you’re craving—this perfect pup gives main character energy, but longs to live that supportive best friend role.

He’s a true prince of a dog—loyal, loving, enchanting golden eyes.A softee in an athletic dog’s body, he’s ready to snuggle on a couch or go on a trail run.

His perfect date is April 25th—just kidding, but his favorite movie is Miss Congeniality. He would adore hanging out with his closest friends and family, eating his favorite snacks, after a jog around a wooded park or scenic neighborhood.

This handsome pup comes off as a confident leading man, but he can be shy with new people and dogs. He likes to take it slow and get to know new friends. McNugget is a slow-burn who is worth the wait!

Is McNugget the dashing dog you’ve been looking for? Apply to adopt McNugget today!

FLVA-A-53155.kennel_description: I'm still settling into life at Fluvanna SPCA, so the staff is continuing to learn more about me each day. Visit the shelter and talk with a team member to find out what they've discovered so far—you may just meet your new best friend!

FLVA-A-53229.kennel_description: Teddy is a sweet guy with a timid nature, who loves his sniffy walks and cuddles with his trusted humans. He is looking for a home that understands the importance of patience and trust-building, so he feels safe and his true colors can shine!

FLVA-A-53071.kennel_description:
Meet Cappo! This handsome guy came to us in January after being rescued from a neglect case, where life wasn’t always kind. At first, the world felt huge and unfamiliar, but thanks to the patience and dedication of our staff, he has blossomed into a happy, social dog who now seeks out affection, enjoys spending time with people, and has discovered that life can be full of good things.

Watching his transformation has been nothing short of incredible. The dog who once didn’t know what love looked like now greets familiar faces with a wagging tail and is ready to make new friends.

This special dog deserves a home that will continue building his confidence, celebrate how far he has come, and give him the love he’s always deserved.

FLVA-A-53231.kennel_description:
Daisy is a sweet girl who just wants a home to bounce around in and then curl up for a good snuggle! She is working hard on her manners and is starting to master her leash skills with the help of treats and a harness!

She has spent some time in a foster home, but is now looking for a couch to land on permanently.

FLVA-A-53232.kennel_description:
Pebbles is a higher energy girl who LOVES to play, especially with tennis balls! She is smart and very food motivated, so staff has been having a lot of fun training with her.

She can be hesitant to meet new people and is sensitive to being touched, so giving affection and cuddles is reserved for her favorite people. She recently spent time in a foster home and after about 2 days she blossomed into the most loving little snuggle bug. 🥰

If you're looking for an adventure buddy who will reward you with a deep bond and lots cuddles, then Pebbles is your girl!

FLVA-A-53302.kennel_description:
Meet Dahlia! Our sweet, sensitive, and silly hippo pitty.

Dahlia came to us after living most of her life as an outside dog, so she is still learning that new people and experiences aren’t scary. But once she is comfortable, she is the silliest goofball and loves to romp and run. With the occasional crash landing right into your lap!

If you’re looking for an active “introvert” of a dog, Dahlia is your girl!

FLVA-A-53317.kennel_description:
I’m a slightly cautious guy but I do love snuggles once I am comfortable. I love hanging out with my brother, Yankees. We are not technically bonded, but I am much more confident when I am with him.

Consider adopting us both!

FLVA-A-53318.kennel_description:
I am a shy guy who loves hanging out with my brother, Red Sox. We are not technically bonded, but I am much more confident when I am with him.

Consider adopting us both!

FLVA-A-53338.kennel_description: I'm still settling into life at Fluvanna SPCA, so the staff is continuing to learn more about me each day. Visit the shelter and talk with a team member to find out what they've discovered so far—you may just meet your new best friend!

FLVA-A-53354.kennel_description:
Meet Chase — aka “Sweet Cheeks” ❤️

Chase is ready to settle into the good life, and his foster mom says he is going to make someone an incredible companion.

He’s a loyal, affectionate guy who is looking for his person. He can be a little unsure about unfamiliar things at first, but he quickly learns to trust—and once he does, get ready for some serious affection.

His foster mom calls him “Sweet Cheeks” because he is always leaning his head against her. Chase wants to be touching his person whenever possible. Sitting at your desk? He’ll lie on your feet. On the couch? He’s ready to snuggle. He’s even well on his way to becoming a lap cat!

Chase also LOVES being petted and brushed. ❤️

Whoever adopts this sweet boy is getting a devoted companion, professional snuggler, and excellent foot warmer.

Come meet Chase and see if you might be the person “Sweet Cheeks” has been waiting for. 🥹❤️

FLVA-A-53368.kennel_description:
Meet Meatloaf!

Meatloaf is a friend to dogs and people! He enjoys a romp in the play park or a walk on the trails.

This energetic, young dog loves to work on his manners—a treat and some patience is the key to success with him.

He'd love a dog sibling or a family who takes him with them on their every day adventures.

Apply to adopt Meatloaf today or come by and meet him in person!

FLVA-A-53413.kennel_description:
Meet Marley!

Marley is a sweet old lady with very limited hearing looking for a home where she can feel safe and loved.

Once Marley learned the routine at the shelter and our staff recognized her hearing impairment, her personality began to shine. Most of her day she is calm and quiet, thoroughly enjoying a cozy nap, but every once in a while, Marley has a pop of playful energy. When she drops into a play bow and gives her grizzled old lady bark, you get to see the puppy in her.

Marley is ready for a quiet home where she is the only pet. Someone who enjoys the simple things, snuggling, and an occasional play session is her perfect match.

If Marley sounds like a match for your home, apply for her today or meet her at the shelter!

FLVA-A-53438.kennel_description:
Meet Hecate!

Hecate is as bewitching as her eponym. This sweet young cat is ready to find her forever home where she can grow and thrive.

Apply for Hecate today or visit the shelter to meet her in person!

FLVA-A-53448.kennel_description:
Meet Grapefruit!

This leggy, blonde hound dog is "as sweet as a sugar coated grapefruit."

He hams it up in the play yard and makes friends everywhere he goes—a real Mr. Rizz-ness.

If you adore a handsome hound with a sparkling personality, apply for him today or visit the shelter to meet him!

FLVA-A-53450.kennel_description:
Meet Scarlett!

Scarlett is a striking beauty who is sure to charm anyone she meets. This sweet young cat is ready to find her forever home where she can grow and thrive.

Apply for Scarlett today or visit the shelter to meet her in person!

FLVA-A-53455.kennel_description:
Meet Woodrow (Woody to his friends!)

This silly guy has classic, goofy lab energy. He could not be more thrilled to someone coming with a leash in hand. When he works on his manners, he is delighted to have snuggles, a treat, or a quick play session as a reward.

He enjoys the company of some dogs in play group, but would like to be a family's one and only dog in the house.

If Woodrow is the kind of sweet re-treat-ver you are looking for, apply for him today or come to the shelter and meet him in person!

FLVA-A-53456.kennel_description:
Meet Benny!

Benny is a shy, sensitive guy with a playful streak a mile wide, once he gets to know you.

He loves other dogs and toys. Play group time is one of Benny's favorite activities. He shows his joyful, silly side bounding in the yard alongside his buds! It's a treat for the staff to watch him relax and have fun.

He may take some time to open up, but its time well spent to get to be a part of Benny's trusted friends.

If Benny is your kind of gentleman, apply for him today or come by the shelter to meet him!

FLVA-A-53457.kennel_description:
Meet Alyssa!

This dandelion fluff come to life is ready for adventure on the trails or a car ride, or, hanging at home and enjoying some snacks and your favorite comfort show.

Alyssa is not your typical husky—she is well-mannered on her leash and is relatively quiet. She does adore a treat—like a typical husky!

If you are looking for a gorgeous gal-Friday, look no further than Alyssa!

Apply for her today, or swing by the shelter to meet her in person!

FLVA-A-53528.kennel_description:
Meet Jay 🐾💙

Jay is an adorable 25-pound adult beagle with all the best beagle qualities: friendly, affectionate, curious, and always ready for an adventure with his person.

Jay is currently in foster, where we’re getting to see what a wonderful companion he is. His foster mom says he loves long walks and is super easy on the leash. And Jay doesn’t believe in walking past strangers—he wants to greet everyone he meets! 😂

When the adventure is over, Jay is more than happy to switch into snuggle mode. He loves cuddling up with his people and playing with soft toys. He’s already proving to be a sweet, social little guy who enjoys being part of whatever his humans are doing.

If you’re looking for a walking buddy, professional snuggler, and 25 pounds of beagle sweetness, Jay might be your guy. ❤️
